questions.question: According to a statistical analysis, which player has the highest playoff rTS% (relative True Shooting percentage) among NBA first options, and what is that percentage?
questions.ground_truth: Reggie Miller has the highest playoff rTS% among NBA first options at 114%. This means he was 14% more efficient than the league average in his playoff era. Kawhi Leonard comes closest at 112%, followed by Stephen Curry and Jerry West at 110%. Even when filtering for just Miller's prime years (1991-2002) when he averaged 24 PPG across 100+ playoff games, his rTS% was 115%, which would still top the list. This efficiency was achieved despite having zero Hall of Fame teammates in their prime (except a 34-year-old Chris Mullin).

questions.question: Quelle équipe NBA a réussi à atteindre les finales sans avoir l'avantage du terrain à domicile durant aucun tour des playoffs, incluant les finales ?
questions.ground_truth: Selon la discussion Reddit, aucune équipe NBA n'a jamais réussi cet exploit dans l'histoire moderne de la ligue. Six équipes ont atteint les finales avec une position inférieure à la 4e seed, mais aucune n'a eu l'avantage du terrain à domicile en finale. La seed la plus basse à atteindre les finales était les Rockets de 1995 qui étaient 6e seed. Les Knicks en 1999 (lock-out season) et le Heat en 2020 sont des exemples notables, mais même eux ont eu l'avantage du terrain à un moment ou un autre. En conclusion, cette situation ne s'est jamais produite dans la NBA.

questions.question: Based on both fan discussions and statistics, is Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's scoring efficiency justified or is he primarily a 'foul merchant' as some Reddit users claim?
questions.ground_truth: Based on the data, SGA's efficiency is genuinely elite. He leads the league with 2485 points in 76 games (32.7 PPG) with a shooting percentage of 51.9% FG. While Reddit discussions mention he gets to the free throw line frequently (600 FTM), his efficiency isn't solely dependent on free throws - his field goal percentage of 51.9% is excellent for a guard with high volume. Reddit users note he has more drives than any player in the last 5 years, and his free throw rate is average compared to other MVPs. The criticism appears somewhat overblown, as top scorers historically get to the line frequently. His True Shooting percentage (TS%) of 61.5% confirms he's genuinely efficient, not just a foul merchant.

questions.question: The Pacers surprised many by reaching the conference finals. Based on statistical evidence from the Excel data and fan reactions from Reddit, what makes them competitive despite being considered underdogs?
questions.ground_truth: The Pacers' competitiveness comes from several factors. Statistically, they have strong contributors: Pascal Siakam provides solid all-around play, Tyrese Haliburton facilitates the offense effectively, and they play with a fast pace that creates more possessions. Reddit discussions emphasize they're fun to watch, play team basketball rather than relying on a single star, and have consistently exceeded expectations (beat the Bucks and Knicks despite being underdogs, upset the Cavs when nobody picked them). Users note the Pacers have been 'preparing and practicing this all year' and have strong coaching from Rick Carlisle. Their success isn't reflected in individual superstar stats but in their collective team play and ability to dictate pace, making them a difficult matchup despite not having the biggest market or the most recognizable stars.

questions.question: D'après les discussions Reddit et les statistiques, pourquoi Reggie Miller est-il considéré comme sous-estimé malgré sa grande efficacité en playoffs ?
questions.ground_truth: Reggie Miller est considéré comme sous-estimé pour plusieurs raisons combinées. Statistiquement, il a le meilleur rTS% (114%) parmi les premiers options en playoffs, dépassant même des légendes comme Jordan, LeBron et Curry. Cependant, Reddit explique qu'il n'a été sélectionné que 5 fois All-Star (moins que Kyle Lowry ou Joe Johnson) et seulement 3 fois All-NBA. Les raisons de cette sous-estimation incluent : (1) il jouait pour une petite franchise (Indiana), (2) son usage était plus faible en saison régulière qu'en playoffs, (3) il était en concurrence avec Michael Jordan pour les spots de guards à l'Est, et (4) son style de jeu basé sur le mouvement sans ballon était moins visible que celui des créateurs ISO. De plus, il n'a jamais gagné de titre, ce qui affecte sa reconnaissance malgré 14 victoires de séries playoffs sans coéquipier Hall of Fame dans leur prime.

questions.question: Comparing Giannis Antetokounmpo's statistical performance with fan opinions from Reddit, is he living up to his reputation this season?
questions.ground_truth: Statistically, Giannis is performing at an elite level: 2037 total points in 67 games (30.4 PPG), 60.1% FG percentage, and 34.6% usage rate - the highest USG% after James Wiseman's small sample. However, Reddit discussions are more mixed. While he's recognized as a top player, there are concerns about his playoff performances and team success. Users note the Bucks have struggled (40-27 record), and some feel Giannis hasn't been able to carry the team as effectively without sufficient help. The general consensus is that Giannis remains an incredible talent individually, but questions remain about whether he can lead the Bucks to championship success, especially with the team's defensive and roster construction issues. His regular season stats are elite, but the broader context suggests he needs more support to achieve championship-level success.
